raw_segments.text: Dutchess! No, by the holy rude, thou know'st ye at well thou cam'st ye on earth to make
the earth my hell. A grievous burden was thy birth to me, tetchy and wayward was thy infancy,
thy school days frightful, dispray'd, wild and furious, thy prime of manhood daring, bold
and venturous, thy age confirm'd, proud, subtle, sly and bloody, more mild, but yet
more harmful, kind and hatred. What comfortable hour canst thou name that ever graced me with
